column1: # Nodes transferred out of the algorithms dimension to models (#95), 2026-10-07.
# Reason: the owner's specification test -- a thing is a model component if
# specifying the NETWORK requires it, and an algorithm if specifying the RUN
# requires it. nn.Dropout(p=0.1) is a module with a placement and a rate.
# Why the obvious alternative test was rejected: "does it survive to inference"
# would split dropout from batch norm, but MC-dropout keeps dropout at inference,
# so the same construct would change dimension by use -- the property-of-the-use
# trap that killed three candidate characteristics in the models dimension.
